title: pamoja profile
description: A node written down as data: what it reads, where it reports, how it decides each reading, how often it samples as its battery drains, and how a dashboard draws it.

$schema.description: The format the file is written in: this schema's address, or a copy of it by the same file name. An editor reads it to check the file as it is typed.

name.description: A stable name, lowercase words joined by hyphens, such as brooder-heater. A shared profile's file carries the same name.

description.description: What the profile is for, in a sentence or two: what it watches or holds, and what it does when a reading crosses a line.

topic.description: The topic each reading is published to, such as poultry/brooder/temperature. One topic, so no + or # wildcards.

reads.description: What the profile reads. The setpoint, bands, and limits under control are in this unit.

quantity.description: The quantity its control decides on, in lowercase words joined by underscores, such as temperature, relative_humidity, soil_moisture, water_level, or pressure.

unit.description: The unit its numbers are in, in lowercase words joined by underscores, such as celsius, percent, meter, or bar.

control.description: How each reading is decided. The kind names the policy and the other fields tune it.

setpoint.title: setpoint
setpoint.description: Holds a reading near a target by switching an output on and off, and alerts when the reading strays too far.
The target reading, such as 32 for a brooder in celsius.

hysteresis.description: Half the deadband around the setpoint. The output switches at the setpoint less and plus this, so it does not chatter.

cooling.description: true for an output that switches on above the band, such as a cooler; false for one that switches on below it, such as a heater or a valve that adds water.

safe_band.description: How far the reading may stray from the setpoint before an OutOfRange alert. No narrower than the hysteresis.

level.title: level
level.description: Watches a falling level and warns before it runs out.

empty.description: The level treated as empty, such as 0.5 for a well in meters.

warn_within.description: Raise RunningOut once the level is on course to reach empty within this many more samples.

surge.title: surge
surge.description: Warns when a reading changes faster than is safe, such as a river rising into a flash flood.

rising.description: true to watch for a rapid rise, false for a rapid fall.

limit.description: The largest safe change between two samples. A bigger one raises ChangingFast.

monitor.title: monitor
monitor.description: Reports readings and decides nothing: no output, no alerts.

custom.title: a kind of your own
custom.description: A policy the library does not ship. Its parameters sit beside the kind, and the program that runs the profile registers the code that decides it.

kind.description: The kind's own name, in lowercase words joined by underscores, such as frost_guard.

additionalProperties.description: A parameter the kind's code reads: a number, true or false, or text.

power.description: How often the node samples as its battery drains. The intervals may not shorten as the charge falls.

active_secs.description: Seconds between samples on a healthy battery.

saver_secs.description: Seconds between samples below saver_below. No shorter than active_secs.

critical_secs.description: Seconds between samples below critical_below. No shorter than saver_secs.

saver_below.description: The state of charge, from 0 to 1, below which the node samples at saver_secs.

critical_below.description: The state of charge below which the node samples at critical_secs. Below saver_below.

hysteresis.description: How far above a threshold the charge must climb to leave the slower cadence, so a charge hovering at a threshold does not switch it every cycle.

presentation.description: How a dashboard draws the node: the readings it adds, a tint, and the words for its own states.

elements.description: The readings and node stats the dashboard draws, in the order they are offered.

messages.description: The words for each state. or event. code the profile introduces, keyed by the code, such as state.lamp_on.

element.description: One reading or node stat on the dashboard.

key.description: The stable key the value travels under, in lowercase words joined by underscores, such as brooder_temperature. Used once per profile.

unit.description: The unit's name, such as celsius, percent, ntu, or state for an on and off reading.

label.description: The label shown when the reader's language has none of its own.

labels.description: The label in other languages, keyed by locale tag, such as fr or sw.

viz.description: The graphic the value is drawn with.

band.description: The safe band, [low, high] in the element's unit, drawn as the graphic's safe zone. The low end comes first.

stat.description: true for telemetry about the node itself, such as a battery or dropped packets, which the dashboard counts apart from the world it measures.

scope.description: Which groups offer the element: always, or { "links": [...] } for groups on those link kinds only, such as mesh.

span.description: true to give a wide graphic two columns.

value.description: The value shown until the first real sample arrives.

state.description: The state shown until the first real sample arrives, for an on and off reading, such as state.lamp_off. Not together with value.

theme.description: A tint for the dashboard. Each color is any CSS color.

accent.description: Links, focus, and the brand mark.

ok.description: A healthy reading, and an in-band gauge.

track.description: The unfilled rail behind gauges and bars.

text.description: One text for every language, or an object of texts keyed by locale tag with an en text the others fall back to.
